wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 07-007 wires the intermission runtime via one src/vanilla facade (wireIntermissionRuntime.ts) re-exporting the read-only src/ui/intermission.ts (createIntermissionState/beginIntermission/checkForAccelerate/tickIntermission, SP_STATE_INITIAL_PAUSE 1..SP_STATE_FINAL 10, SP_*_DELTA 2/2/2/3, WI_MAX_PERCENT 100, WI_SHOW_NEXT_LOC_TICS 140, TICRATE 35, music/sound cue + state/round/input/result/tick-result types). VANILLA_INTERMISSION_RUNTIME_INVARIANTS pins five rules (10-state SP machine; fixed stat deltas clamped at 100; accelerate skips the pause; mus_inter cue; world-done transition after final state). The focused test exercises the constants, the callable runtime entry points (createIntermissionState returns an object), the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums; single-module barrel. Eligible after 08-009 + 11-007 completed.
